_doc: Streamed worlds (ADR-0038, docs/RWG_V2_PLAN.md §1.2). Distances in metres from the player to a region's rect (or a building's frame); budgets in milliseconds of main thread a frame. region: load/unload are the attach ring and its hysteresis, prefetch composes into the disk cache only (plus prefetch_ahead along the heading), heading_weight pulls regions ahead of the player forward in the queue, first_area is what the loading screen waits for, max_attached caps regions held in memory at 1 m. poi: plan/build/free rings, at most max_built buildings standing.

built_whole._doc: A world built whole that builds by distance (the main map, GameWorld.poi_ring): the boot raises the buildings within boot m of the spawn, the rest rise in the background nearest first out to build m, or the preset's view distance + 100 m if more (PoiManager), so none appears in sight.
